tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ las bzhi mchog lnga'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rab 'byams phrin las snang ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs so//

rdo rje nyi mas 'khrul rtog mun bsal ste// ye shes snang bas dngos grub kun dga'i skyes// sbyin mdzad bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// btud nas phrin las bzhi yi sreg blugs spel// de yang snying po'i rgyud las/ dbyibs dang kha dog mtshan ldan par// zhal du gyur pa'i me bus la// bza' btung bro ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// las bzhi'i mchod pa rab tu sbyin// zhes gsungs pa'i don phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro kun 'dus rdo rje phag mo'i lha sngags la brten pa'i las bzhi dang mchog lnga'i sbyin sreg ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la gsum/ sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po las lnga char gyi sngon 'gror sa yi cho ga bya ba ni/ so so'i dus skabs la bab pa dang*/ las gang yin rung bar bsngags shing rung ba'i gnas su dkar gtor dang*/ gser skyems bshams la/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor phyag rgya gcig pa'i bskyed bzlas sam/ bsdu na/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje phag mo khros ma nag mo'i skur gyur/ oṃ baṃ badzra bha ra hi kro dhī kā li ha ri ni sa ā bai sha ya: zhes brgya rtsa tsam bzlas pas nga rgyal bzung la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs gsum gyis gtor ma bsngos la/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod spyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di// bdag zhu khyed kyis bstsal du gsol// sarba bhū ta gatstsha sa gnang zhing rang gnas gzhi der thim par bsam la gser skyems dang gtor ma gtsang sar phul/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo sa la reg pas rtsa sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/

oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ lan bdun bzlas la kun rdzob kyis sbyang ba dang*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa'i chos nyid la dran pa bzhag nas/ shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra 'i sngags brjod pas don dam gyis sbyang ba bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga las/ dang po zhi ba'i sbyin sreg la'ang*/ cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes rim dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ zla ba yar ngo bkra shis pa'i nyi ma'i srod kyi char shis pa'i sa la 'jam zhing khod snyoms pa'i stegs bu dkar po khru gang las mi chung ba gru bzhi pa byas pa'i ngogs su/ rdul tshon kha dog dkar pos chos 'byung bsnol ma rdor rwa me ri zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lte bar padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte dbus mthing gar baṃ yig mthing nag dang*/ 'dab mar 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i srog gi mtshon byed ha ri ni sa'i yig 'bru bzhi las so so'i rigs kyi kha dog can dgod/ gcad tshon sogs kyang dmar skya las nag po sogs tshon sel gyis ma phog pa gal che/ thab kyi khar bal bu/ lcang ma/ 'om bu sogs 'o ma can gyi bud shing ngam/ ba yi lci ba srog chags med pa me ri'i steng la zlum por brtsegs la tsandan dkar po'i chu 'o ma dang sbyar bas bran/ shar lhor me tshang bca'/ thab stegs kyi gra bzhir mda' bzhi btsugs pa srad bu dkar po 1$0000260 las so sor rang mdog dgos/ mchan/) 1$0000300 bsnol mar sbrel ba la dar dkar pos dgab/ de'i shar lho'i zur du mda' dar dmar po 'dzugs/ de dang nye bar rang gi mdun du dgang blug kha sbyar ba/ rdor dril thod rnga/ bsang chu/ me tog gi snod/ thugs dam bskul ba'i rdzas yungs dkar sogs dang*/ rang gi g.yon du 'o ma 'bras chan dang dngul gyi phye me tog dkar po rnams bsres pa'i mar dkar gyi gtor zlum ril bu drug gi bskor ba 'das ma 'das kyi che chung gnyis/

gos zung dkar po dang so rtsi zung re/ dung shel gyi rgyan/ ku sha zung bsdebs lnga dang*/ sman raka nyer spyod/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ g.yas su bsreg rdzas mar khu/ las mthun gyi yam shing zhi bar mdzub gang ba'i rtser ( 1$0000260 rgyas par khru gang ba lo 'bras can/ dbang la sor lnga'am gsum pa/ drag por sor bcu gnyis sam bzhi pa/ mchan/ 1$0000300 )mngar gsum dang mar khus nyug pa dang*/ 1$0000260 drag por mar nag tshil zhun dug khrag / 1$0000300 de bzhin du mngar gsum sbyar ba'i zhun mar dang*/ 1$0000260 dbang drag la til mar/ 1$0000300 khyad par gyi rdzas til dkar po dang*/ 1$0000260 sdig sbyong dang drag por nag po/ 1$0000300 gur gum 'o mar bcas pa'i zho zan/ 1$0000260 drag por snum nag dang zhun chen khrag gis sbrus pa/ 1$0000300 'bras ma grug pa dang*/ so ba gra ma med pa dang*/ nas dang*/ sran ma dang*/ 1$0000260 drag por nag po/ 1$0000300 gro dang*/ dūrba dang*/ 1$0000260 drag por dum bcad byas pa/ 1$0000300 ku sha dang*/ gzhan yang bshal sman dang dug rigs ma yin pa'i rin chen 'bru sman sna tshogs sbyar ba rnams/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rim pas nyis rim du 'god/ spros pa la dga' na dar dkar gyi na bza' dang*/ shel gtso bor gyur pa'i rin po che dkar po'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i chas zhugs dang*/ sgrub pa po kha shar du phyogs pas sems skyil gyis ku sha sogs gtsang shing 'jam pa'i stan la dang ba'i sems kyis 'khod do// gnyis pa cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba ni/ brgyud 'debs skyabs sems nas brtsam bzlas pa stong tshigs mchod bstod kyi bar bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bya/ rab gnas dang sgrub mchod sogs dang 'brel ba'i tshe ni/ oṃ baṃ badzra bha ra hi kro dhī kā li ha ri ni sa ā bai sha ya: zhes brjod pas/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phag mo khros ma nag mo gnyis pa'i rnam par thon nas sbyin sreg gi las rim la 'jug par

mos la/ bsang chu sgrub pa la sogs pa rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ saḥkarma dhā ki nī hūm̐ phaṭ: cung zad bzlas pas bgegs bsang ba'i nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs/ rdor dril/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐ zhes pas rdo rje snying gar gsor/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe āḥ sa dril bu dkur brten/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā gā ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ gis rdor dril bsnol ma'i 'khyud rgya dang bcas dam tshig gsum bzung*/ gsum pa dngos gzhi la 'jig rten dang 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thog mar mchod bsreg gi rdzas rnams la bsang chu 'thor te/ mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐: gnas khang dur khrod chen po'i gzhal med khang: ye shes bkod pa 'byams klas 'od 'bar dbus: nyer spyod 'dod yon drag po'i longs spyod kun: bde stong mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por gyur: oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai widya shabda pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa dharma dhā tu sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥmūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta kuṇḍa lī hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ka pā la rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba ling ta sarba kā ma gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: zhes nang mchod sngags rnams so sor lan gsum res byin gyis brlabs/ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ: zhes rgya cher spel lo// bsreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsis bran la rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas reg cing*/ oṃ swā hā/ phyag rgya de nyid kyis yam shing la/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhun mar la/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ 'bru rnams la/ oṃ dzriṃ swā hā/ rdzas gzhan rnams la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i bcud can/

mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa so so'i las sgrub pa la thogs pa med pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ swā āṃ hā/ zhes lan bdun dang*/ oṃ bi ma la agna ye swā hā/ zhes sogs rdzas sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ gtsub shing las byung ba'am dge 'dun gyi tshang mang las byung ba'i me du ba med pa'i dpal 'bar thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung ste g.yas su bskor zhing sbar la/ oṃ badzra dzñā na ḍā ki nī dzwa la raṃ: rlung g.yab kyis lan gsum g.yab cing*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod/ 'bar ba na hūm̐ lan bdun bzlas pa'i blug gzar gyi mar khus kyang gso bar bya'o// de nas ku sha sngo ljang dri ma med pa la las bum gyi chus bran te/ oṃ a mṛta kuṇḍa lī sarba bighnāṃ nā sha ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bsangs la/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum ni mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swā hā zhes brjod de/ ku sha gnyis gnyis rtse mo gshibs pa dag sgrub pa po'i mdun ngos kyi thab kyi kha khyer nas thog mar rtse mo shar dang de nas lho nub byang du bstan la phyogs bzhir dgram zhing rgyab ma rnams kyi rtse mo mdun ma rnams kyi rtsa bas non par bya zhing*/ slar thab tu rtse mo shar du bstan pa'i ku sha ba lang gi rna ba lta bu ha cang mi ring bas g.yogs so// ( 1$0000260 rgyas pa dang mchog la/ thog mar rtse mo byang dang slar byang bstan gyis dgab/ de bzhin dbang la/ nub dang nub bstan dgab/ drag por/ lho dang lhor bstan dgab bo// 1$0000300 ) de nas thab bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung kha dog dkar zhing dbyibs zlum pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma'i lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/

kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor zhing gra bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba/ rgya dpangs sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du me yi dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ dkar po las dbyug tho dkar po raṃ gyis mtshan par gyur te/ de las me lha dkar po drang srong gi cha byad can/ sha skem pa/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dkar po dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang po dbyug tho/ gnyis pa na bgrang phreng*/ g.yon dang po na ril ba spyi blugs/ g.yon gnyis pa skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya can drang srong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs par bsam la/ lag g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mthe bong g.yab cing*/ mda' dar bzung la/ oṃ/ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// oṃ pā ba ka agne ye ā gatstsha yaḥ zhes dang/ ma ma shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes mda' dar g.yab cing mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la las bum gyi chu dang las sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ ( rgyas pa dang mchog gi skabs/ ma ma puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang gi skabs/ ma ma wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ drag po la/ sarba sha trūn mā ra ya phaṭḥ ces so sor sbyar ro// ) oṃ badzra aṅku shā dzaḥ lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas bkug / oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ zhags pa'i rgyas bcings/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ lcags sgrog gi rgyas gnyis med du byas/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥ dril bu'i rgyas dgyes pa bskyed/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang dam pa 'dis// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig

/oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha swā hā/ bdag cag me tog spos rab dang*// spyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha hoḥ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐/ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad stsol mdzad pa'i// bdag gzhan don 'grub sa la bzhugs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la 'dud// ces bstod/ bum chu gtor zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas dbang gi lha mo byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa spros te dbang bskur/ oṃ ratna a laṃ kā ra swā hā/ zhes de rnams kyis rgyan btags par bsam/ de nas byon skyems ni/ me lha zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pas cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags dang*/ ( drag po'i skabs me lha khros pa'i zhal rab tu gdangs pa'i ljags dang zhes dmigs bsal kha bsgyur dgos/ ) gzar bu gnyies kyi kha la raṃ yig 'od zer gyi phung por 'bar bas mtshan pas sreg blug gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs te gsol bar bsam la/ lag gnyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur gyis/ ( 1$0000260 rgyas par mthe mdzub rtse sprad rin chen khu tshur/ dbang la srin mdzub rtse sprad padma'i rgya/ drag por mthe bong mdzub chung rtse sprad khro bo'i khu tshur/ 1$0000300 ) dgang blug bzung nas/ oṃ bi ma la agna ye swā hā/ zhes g.yas pa'i blugs gzar bdun gyis g.yon pa'i dgang gzar bkang ba'i gzar bu kha sbyar pus mo'i phyir mi 'da' bas g.yas su bskor zhing*/ 1$0000260 drag por nang du mi 'da'i g.yon skor bya/ 1$0000300 ) oṃ pā ba ka agna ye zhes pa'i mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi/ nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes pa lta bu spel tshig sbrel bas 'bul/ ( rgyas pa'i skabs/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes thams cad puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang skabs/ 'khor dang bcas par brtan g.yo srid zhi'i yon tan thams cad pā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ drag po la/ 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra phaṭaḥ mchog gi skabs/ sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs te sa bcu lam lnga'i yon tan mthar phyin nas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i sdongs grog siddhi pha la hoḥ zhes bsgyur/ ) tshul de ltar lan gsum du 'bul zhing me pra brtags/ de nas rdzas rnams las/ khu ba'i rang bzhin can rnams zhal dang*/ yam shing*/ dūrba/ ku sha sogs 'od kyis dkyil 'khor dang*/ zho zan dang*/ til sogs phyag gis mtshon par 'bul bar mos te/ lag gis gzung du btub pa rnams g.yas pa'i mtheb srin sbyar ba'i mchog sbyin gyi tshul dang*/ de las gzhan pa rnams blug gzar gyis 'bul zhing*/ 'bul sngags dang go rim ni/ yam shing*/

oṃ pe she hasta badzra ya swā hā/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mar khu/ oṃ bi ma la agna ye swā hā/ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ til/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzrā ya swā hā/ sdig pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zho zan dang zas mchog / oṃ sarba saṃ ba de swā hā/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badzra puṣṭā ya swā hā/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ so ba/ oṃ badzra bi dza ya swā hā/ nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ shugs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ ma hā bā lā ya swā hā/ stobs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gro / oṃ badzra ghasma rāe ye swā hā/ nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dūrba/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ tshe ring ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ku sha / oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzrā ya swā hā/ srung ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rdzas gzhan rnams la/ oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra phu le ma hā da ra pe sha /shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bdun la sogs pas phul ba'i mthar bdag cag dpon slob sogs gong gi byon skyems skabs ltar gsol/ ( rgyas pa'i skabs/ puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang la/ pā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ drag por/ mā ra ya phaṭaḥ mchog la/ siddhi pha la hoḥ zhes bsgyur la so so'i 'dod gsol sbyar/ ) de dag gi skabs su dmigs pa ni/ bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rtsa gzhung las/ sreg rdzas bdud rtsi phul bas me lha mnyes te:

'od zer byung nas bdag gi thugs kar phog pas: lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa bsregs te: slar 'od zer chu rgyun lta bus bkrus par bsam ste: bshang ba'i lam nas thon par bsam pa'am: yang na me lha'i 'od kyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa la sogs pa: snying ga nas brtsam ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bton te rdzas la bstims pas mchod pa ni man ngag go: de bzhin du nad dang: dgra dang: 'byung po'i nad la sogs pa thams cad la'ang sbyar bar bya'o: gal te pha ma'am slob dpon la sogs pa'i ched du byed na'ang de bzhin du bya'o: zhes so/ 1$0000260 de bzhin rgyas dbang drag mchog gi las so so'i dmigs pa rig pas 'phrul zhing bsam par bya'o// 1$0000300 ) skabs 'dir spro na dngos grub blang ba'i don du dgang blug kyang 'bul bar gsungs shing ma 'byor kyang chad skyon med do// gang ltar yang*/ ā ka ro 'i sngags lan gsum gyis gtor ma bsngos la skabs 'dir thab tu 'bul mi dgos/ bstod pa ni/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyob pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa// rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul// nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs// bgrang phreng 'dzin zhing rig sngags gsung*// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gundhe bsnams// chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// yig brgya brjod la nongs pa bshags/ yungs dkar thab tu gtor la/ na mo/ rig pa'i rgyal po khyod kyis las thams cad byed pas bsreg rdzas lha yi zhal du 'bul ba dang*/ me nyid ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlabs nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi/

nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ ( rgyas pa'i skabs/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes thams cad rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ dbang la/ 'khor dang bcas par brtan g.yo srid zhi'i yon tan thams cad dbang du 'dus pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ drag po la/ 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlog pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ mchog la/ sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs te sa bcu lam lnga'i yon tan mthar phyin nas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob pa'i sdongs grogs mdzad du gsol/ ces sgyur/ ) oṃ āḥhūm̐ muṃ/ ye shes kyi me lha thab kyi shar lhor gshegs par gyur/ gnyis pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa la/ gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed pa ni/ ku sha'i 'thor g.yab kyis bsang chu 'thor zhing*/ las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ a: stong nyid 'od gsal dbyings kyi mkha': thig le chen po'i klong yangs su: rig pa'i ye shes rang snang ba: las kyi dngos grub ji snyed kun: mos pa bzhin du 'byung ba'i gnas: mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs rdo rje'i thab: gos dkar yum gyi ngo bo nyid: dam tshig me lha'i lto ba dang: gnyis med me lce 'khyil ba'i dbus: bhrūm̐ las drag po'i gzhal med khang: zhes pa nas/ lte bar pad nyi bam ro'i steng: zhes pa'i bar rtsa ba'i phrin las ltar ro// sbyin sreg rkyang pa'i skabs su ni brten pa lha bskyed nas spyan 'dren pa sogs las rim bstod pa'i rjes bar byed pa yin mod/ 'dir ni sgrub mchod dang rjes su 'brel ba'i dbang du byas te/ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhengs shig bla ma yi dam lha: sogs nas/ e ā ralli hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: zhes pa'i bar spyan 'dren gyi tshig brjod pa dang bstun las rdor gyis dkyil 'khor mdun song la lha sngags rnams la

badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ btags pa brjod cing sgrub dkyil las me tog gis mtshon par spyan drangs pa slob dpon la g.yas su bskor te/ g.yon phyogs nas phul ba las me tog thab tu dor ba dang mnyam du des lha so so'i sngags brjod mthar gsal gdab pa ni/ bde stong ye shes rdo rje'i sngags: zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra dzñā na dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la ma hā su kha ātma ko3 haṃ: zhes phag mo rigs lnga/ gnas yul gyi dpa' bo dpa' mo/ las dang dam tshig gi ḍā ki bskyed pa'i bar dang*/ hūm̐: yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa yi: sogs phyi nang gsang ba khyad par gyis mchod cing*/ hūm̐: bde gshegs kun gyi sogs kyis bstod pa'ang bya/ de nas/ nyang gter lha lnga'i gzhung las/ rtsa ba'i phag mo 'gyur ba med: phrin las phag mo bsgyur zhing sgom: zhes pa'i don ltar/ dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pa'i lha thams cad las/ zhi ba'i skabs/ zla ba chu shel lta bu'i 'od zer dkar po'i phreng ba zhing thams cad du khyab par 'char bas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad par bsam/ ( rgyas pa'i skabs/ gser btso ma lta bu'i 'od zer zhing thams cad du khyab par 'char bas rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad par bsam zhes bsgyur/ dbang gi skabs/ rjes su chags pa'i 'od zer dmar po bdud rtsi'i zil mngar can zhing thams cad du spro bas rab 'byams dbang gi phrin las mdzad par dmigs/ drag po'i skabs/ tsha zhing rtsub pa'i 'od zer ljang nag 'phros pas tshar gcod drag po'i phrin las mdzad par bsam mo// mchog ni rgyas par mtshungs so// ) byon skyems ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pas cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags rdo rje dkar po'i ( rgyas par ser po'i/ dbang dmar po'i/) rnam pa can dang*/ gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la hūm̐ yig 'od zer gyi phung po 'bar bas mtshan pas sreg blug gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs te gsol bar bsam la/ ( drag po'i skabs/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams zhal rab tu gdangs pa'i ljags rdo rje mthing ga'i rnam pa can dang

sogs sgyur/ ) oṃ baṃ badzra bha ra hi kro dhī kā li ha ri ni sa ā bai sha ya: zhes rtsa sngags bdun gyis dgang zhing*/ mthar rtsa sngags de la/ dhā ka dhā ki nī sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes lan gcig sbyar bas phul/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod sogs spel tshig me lha'i skabs ltar sbyar/ (mchog sbyin skabs mjug tshig / mchog gi dngos grub siddhi pha la hoḥ zhes sgyur ro// ) de nas yam shing la sogs pa'i rdzas gzhan rnams rtsa sngags bha ra hi'i mthar/ dhā ka dhā ki nī sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes lha sngags lan re'i mthar/ oṃ pe she hasta badzra ya swā hā/ zhes rdzas sngags bcu sogs ji ltar rigs pas phul la/ spel tshig gong ltar sbrel/ tshul de lta bu'i rdzas gzhan rnams kyang brgya'am sum cu nyer gcig sogs skabs dang bstun te phul/ ( yang bsnyen pa sogs kyi kha skong la/ bsgrub pa po'i nad gdon sdig sgrib gsang sngags kyi lhag chad sogs bzlas pa'i nyes skyon thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hāḥ zhes dmigs bsal dang*/ rdzas til gtso bor 'bul zhing spro na 'dod gsol dang rdzas sogs padma mkha' 'gro'i me skong skabs ltar 'bul yang legs/ ) de yang rtsa gzhung las/ rdzas re re dang sngags re re spel la 'bul: sngags nyung la rdzas mang ba ni spang bar bya'o: rdzas nyung la sngags mang ba ni 'gal ba med do: zhes gsungs/ rdzas rnams rdzogs nas las 'chol ba'i tshe/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis zla ba chu shel gyi bum pa bdud rtsi dkar pos gang ba 'dzin pas/ zla ba la gnas pa'i bsgrub bya'i steng phyogs nas khrus byas nas sdig sgrib dang nad gdon la sogs pa thams cad dag cing zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsam la dmigs pa'i gsal snang la rtse gcig tu sems 'dzin pa ni rno la ngar gyis gdags pa bzhin no// ( rgyas pa'i skabs/ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsi dang rin po ches gang ba 'dzin pas/

zla ba ser po la gnas pa'i bsgrub bya'i steng phyogs nas bdud rtsi dang rin po che'i char phab pas/ de'i lus dang khyim gang ste tshe dang bsod nams nor dang longs spyod thams cad rgyas par bsam/ dbang gi skabs/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas gang 'dod pa rang dbang med par dbang du 'dus par bsam/ drag po'i skabs/ lha tshogs rnams las 'od zer nag po me lce lta bur 'phros pa las mtshon cha'i char bab pas dgra bgegs thams cad brlags par bsam mo// mchog gi skabs/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las gser btso ma lta bu'i 'od zer byung ba rang la phog pas nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ sa dang lam gyi yon tan mthar phyin nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bsam mo// ) slar yang dgang blug sngar bzhin 'bul/ oṃ badzra wast+raṃ ya swā hā/ zhes gos gsar pa dang*/ oṃ badzra tambu lā ya swā hā/ zhes rdo thal med pa'i so rtsi 'bul/ gter gzhung gi tshogs bsdus skabs 'dir sbyar zhing tshogs phud thab kyi dkyil dang*/ lhag ma mchod skabs thab kyi zur du 'bul/ nang dang gsang ba'i tshogs mchod kyang byas pas de dang de'i sbyin sreg kyang zhar byung du 'grub cing dgos pa che bar gsungs pas/ tshogs kyi bdud rtsi cung zad rol te/ ho: snying dbus mi shigs thig le'i ngang: stong gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i klong: dbyings kyi pho nya 'du 'bral med: ye shes mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'phro: spyi bor dzā landha ra sogs: rtsa khams gnas yul dur khrod du: 'gro 'ong rlung gis las kun byed: bde stong thig le dkar dmar gzugs: dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs dang bcas: til gyi gong bu kha bye ltar: snang stong 'od skur shigs se shig: a haṃ sngags kyi rang sgrar bcas: bde chen bdud rtsi'i sreg blug rol: yul dang dbang po gnyis med par:

dgyes mnyam mchog gi mchod pas bskang: tha mal snang zhen nyams chag bshags: rtsa rlung thig le'i bar chad sol: dga' ba bzhi yi ye shes spor: stong pa bzhi yi 'od gsal skyed: thams cad ka dag gnyug ma'i ngang: lhun gyis grub pa'i mchog dbang skur: badzra dhā tu dzñā na lo ka dhā ki nī maṇḍa la ma hā su kha pū dza ho: zhes brjod cing bsam/ drod thob pas gsang ba'i tshogs 'khor rdo rje'i glu gar bcas dgos par gsungs kyang thun mong du ma dā na dang*/ zhun mar cung zad kyi sku mnye snying gar byugs shing*/ ho: shes rab padma e yi dbyings: thabs kyi rdo rje waṃ yig gzugs: snyoms 'jug bde ba'i mchod sprin gyis: phung khams skye mched ye shes dbyings: dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma: zag med dgyes pa chen po bskyed: snang sems 'pho ba'i bag chags sbyongs: zag bcas thig le'i sred zhen sgrol: rgyu 'bras gnyis su mi phyed pa'i: bcu drug dga' ba'i pho nya mos: lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes spel: dwangs ma mi shigs gsum ldan gyis: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i go 'phang la: mngon par byang chub dngos grub stsol: ma hā su kha siddhi sa ma ya a haṃ: zhes pa'i don bsgoms nas mthar thug de kho na nyid dbyings rig dbyer med kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas so so'i dbang po'i khyad par bzhin dngos dang rjes mthun gyi dgos pa dang phan yon 'thob par 'gyur ro// tshogs kyi lha chog 'dir bya'o// oṃ sarba dzñā na dhā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pas mchod/ hūm̐: bde gshegs kun gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las rnam 'phrul sa gsum khyab par snang: las dang ye shes dngos grub thogs med stsol: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: ces bstod/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya ma nu pā lā ya/

badzra ḍā ki nī twe no pa tiṣṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ/ shre yāṃḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ ḍā ki nī mā me muñtsa/ ḍā ki nī bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes nongs pa bshags/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mūṃ zhes brjod cing*/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel tshe/ dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor la gshegs par bsam zhing*/ maṇḍal me tog gis mtshon par sgrub dkyil ga la bar spyan drangs la rtsa sngags la badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ btags pas stims/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa rang la thim par bsam/ sreg rkyang gi skabs su ni ye shes pa chos dbyings su gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/

'on kyang bla med thun mong ma yin pa'i skabs 'dir dam dbye gnyis med dbugs rngub pa'i sbyor ba dang bstun rang la bstims pas mi shigs pa'i thig ler ro gcig tu bsams kyang legs so// gsum pa rjes rim ni/ las sngags kyis bsang*/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa me lha ye shes pa thab dbus su spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ de nas dgang blug / me lha zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pas sogs gshegs skyems bdun lnga gsum gang 'os 'bul/ gos zung dang*/ so rtsi sngags bcas 'das pa'i me lha'i skabs ltar dang*/ rdzas lhag rnams rdzas so so'i sngags lnga'am gsum re'i mthar/ oṃ pā ba ka agna ye bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyis/ rdzas dang yo byad ma tshogs pa dang*/ ting 'dzin ma gsal ba dang*/ cho ga lhag pa dang*/ nyams pa dang*/ lha gong 'og nor pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sbyar bas 'bul/ rdzas so sor mi ldang na gcig tu bsdus nas 'bul kyang rung bar gsungs/ ( rgyas sogs las gzhan la/ thams cad kyis nongs pa gang bgyis pa'i nyes tshogs zhi ste/ rgyas par srid zhi'i yon tan rgyas par gyur cig puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang la brtan g.yo srid zhi'i yon tan thams cad pā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ drag por gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭaḥ mchog la srid zhi'i yon tan rgyas par gyur cig puṣṭiṃ ku ru siddhi pha la hoḥ zhes sgyur ro// ) sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyun du byed na rdzas lhag bzhag rung*/ mi byed na skabs 'di nyid du rings par 'bul gsungs so// mthar/ oṃ agne de wa puṣpe nas/ shabda pra tītstsha hoḥ zhes nyer spyod kyis mchod cing*/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/
